ja527:1.1: Nivesanaṃ kassa nu 'daṃ Sunanda pākārena paṇḍumayena guttaṃ, kā dissati aggisikhā va dūre vehāsayaṃ pabbatagge va acci.
ja527:2.1: Dhītā n' ayaṃ kassa Sunanda hoti, suṇisā n' ayaṃ kassa atho pi bhariyā, akkhāhi me khippam id' eva puṭṭho: avāvaṭā, yadivā atthi bhattā ti.
ja527:3.1: Ahaṃ hi jānāmi janinda etaṃ matyā ca petyā ca atho pi assā, tath' eva so puriso bhūmipāla rattiṃdivaṃ appamatto tav' atthe.
ja527:4.1: Iddho ca phīto ca subāḷhiko ca amacco te aññataro janinda, tass' esā bhariyā Ahipārakassa Ummadantī nāmadheyyena rājā 'ti.
ja527:5.1: Ambho ambho nāmam idaṃ imissā matyā ca petyā ca kataṃ susādhu, tathā hi mayhaṃ apalokayantī ummattakaṃ Ummadantī akāsīti.
ja527:6.1: Sā puṇṇamāse migamandalocanā upāvisī puṇḍarīkattacaṅgī, dve puṇṇamāyo tadahū amaññaṃ disvāna pārāpatarattavāsiniṃ.
ja527:7.1: Aḷārapamhehi subhehi vagguhi palobhayantī maṃ yadā udikkhati vijambhamānā harat' eva me mano jātā vane kimpurisīva pabbate.
ja527:8.1: Tadā hi brahatī sāmā āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā ekaccavasanā nārī migī bhantā v' udikkhati.
ja527:9.1: Kadāssu maṃ tambanakhā sulomā bāhāmudū candanasāralittā vaṭṭaṅgulī sannatavīrakuttiyā nārī upaññissati sīsato subhā.
ja527:10.1: Kadāssu maṃ kañcanamāluracchadā dhītā Tirīṭissa vilākamajjhā mudūhi bāhāhi palissajissati brahāvane jātadumaṃ va māluvā.
ja527:11.1: Kadāssu lākhārasarattasucchavī bindutthanī puṇḍarīkattacaṅgī mukhaṃ mukhena upanāmayissati soṇḍo va soṇḍassa surāya thālaṃ.
ja527:12.1: Yathāddasaṃ naṃ tiṭṭhantiṃ sabbagattaṃ manoramaṃ tato sakassa cittassa nāvabodhāmi kiñcanaṃ.
ja527:13.1: Ummadantī mayā diṭṭhā āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā, na supāmi divārattiṃ sahassaṃ va parājito.
ja527:14.1: Sakko ca me varaṃ dajjā, so ca labbhetha me varo: ekarattiṃ dirattiṃ vā bhaveyyaṃ Ahipārako Ummadantyā ramitvāna, Sivirājā tato siyā ti.
ja527:15.1: Bhūtāni me bhūtapatī namassato āgamma yakkho idam evam abravi: rañño mano Ummadantyā niviṭṭho, dadāmi te taṃ, parivārayassū 'ti.
ja527:16.1: Puññā ca dhaṃse amaro na c' amhi, jano ca no pāpam idan ti jaññā, bhuso ca ty-āssa manaso vighāto datvā piyaṃ Ummadantiṃ adiṭṭhā ti.
ja527:17.1: Janinda nāññatra tayā mayā vā sabb' āpi kammassa katassa jaññā yan te mayā Ummadantī padinnā, bhusehi rājā vanathaṃ sajāhi.
ja527:18.1: Yo pāpakaṃ kamma karaṃ manusso so maññatī: mā-y-idha maññiṃsu aññe, passanti bhūtāni karontam etaṃ yuttā ca ye honti narā pathavyā.
ja527:19.1: Añño nu te ko 'dha naro pathavyā saddheyya lokasmi: na sā piyā ti, bhuso ca ty-āssa manaso vighāto datvā piyaṃ Ummadantiṃ adiṭṭhā.
ja527:20.1: Addhā piyā mayha janinda esā, na sā mamaṃ appiyā bhūmipāla, gacch' eva tvaṃ Ummadantiṃ bhadante sīho va selassa guhaṃ upeti.
ja527:21.1: Na pīḷitā attadukkhena dhīrā sukhapphalaṃ kamma pariccajanti, sammohitā cāpi sukhena mattā na pāpakaṃ kamma samācaranti.
ja527:22.1: Tuvaṃ hi mātā ca pitā ca mayhaṃ bhattā patī posako devatā ca, dāso ahaṃ tuyha saputtadāro, yathāsukhaṃ Sibba karohi kāmaṃ.
ja527:23.1: Yo issaro 'mhīti karoti pāpaṃ katvā ca so n' uttapate paresaṃ na tena so jīvati dīgham āyu, devāpi pāpena samekkhare na. Aññātakaṃ
ja527:24.1: sāmikehi padinnaṃ dhamme ṭhitā ye paṭicchanti dānaṃ paṭicchakā dāyakā cāpi tattha sukhapphalaṃ ñeva karonti kammaṃ.
ja527:25.1: Añño nu te ko 'dha naro pathavyā saddheyya lokasmi: na sā piyā ti bhuso ca ty-āssa manaso vighāto datvā piyaṃ Ummadantiṃ adiṭṭhā.
ja527:26.1: Addhā piyā mayha janinda esā, na sā mamaṃ appiyā bhūmipāla yan te mayā Ummadantī padinnā, bhusehi rājā vanathaṃ sajāhi.
ja527:27.1: Yo attadukkhena parassa dukkhaṃ sukhena vā attasukhaṃ dahāti yath' ev' idaṃ mayha tathā paresaṃ so evaṃ jānāti sa vedi dhammaṃ.
ja527:28.1: Añño nu te ko dha naro pathavyā saddheyya etc.
ja527:29.1: Janinda jānāsi piyā mam' esā, na sā mamaṃ appiyā bhūmipāla, piyena te dammi piyaṃ janinda, piyadāyino deva piyaṃ labhanti.
ja527:30.1: So nūn' ahaṃ vadhissāmi attānaṃ kāmahetukaṃ, na hi dhammaṃ adhammena ahaṃ vadhituṃ ussahe.
ja527:31.1: Sace tuvaṃ mayha satiṃ janinda na kāmayāsi naraviriyaseṭṭha cajāmi naṃ sabbajanassa Sibba, mayā pamuttaṃ tato nam avhayesi. Adūsiyañ
ja527:32.1: ce Ahipāraka tvaṃ cajāsi katte ahitāya ty-āssa mahā ca te upavādo pi assa na cāpi ty-āssa nagaramhi pakkho.
ja527:33.1: Ahaṃ sahissaṃ upavādam etaṃ nindaṃ pasaṃsaṃ garaham pi sabbaṃ, mam etam āgacchatu bhūmipāla, yathāsukhaṃ Sibba karohi kāmaṃ.
ja527:34.1: Yo n' eva nindaṃ na puna-ppasaṃsaṃ ādiyatī garahaṃ no pi pūjaṃ sirī ca lakkhī ca apeti tamhā āpo suvuṭṭhī va yathā thalamhā.
ja527:35.1: Yaṃ kiñci dukkhaṃ ca sukhañ ca etto dhammātisāraṃ va manovighātaṃ urasā ahaṃ paccupadissāmi sabbaṃ pathavī yathā thāvarānaṃ tasānaṃ.
ja527:36.1: Dhammātisāraṃ va manovighātaṃ dukkhañ ca n' icchāmi ahaṃ paresaṃ, eko p' imaṃ hārayissāmi bhāraṃ dhamme ṭhito kañci na tāpayanto.
ja527:37.1: Saggūpagaṃ puññakammaṃ janinda, mā me tuvaṃ antarāyaṃ akāsi, dadāmi te Ummadantiṃ pasanno rājā va yaññe dhanaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ.
ja527:38.1: Addhā tuvaṃ katte hitesi mayhaṃ, sakhā mamaṃ Ummadantī tuvañ ca, nindeyyuṃ devā pitaro ca sabbe, pāpañ ca passa abhisamparāyaṃ.
ja527:39.1: Na h' et' adhammaṃ Sivirāja vajjuṃ sanegamā jānapadā ca sabbe yan te mayā Ummadantī padinnā, bhusehi rāja vanathaṃ sajāhi.
ja527:40.1: Addhā tuvaṃ katte hitesi mayhaṃ sakhā mamaṃ Ummadantī tuvañ ca, satañ ca dhammāni sukittitāni samuddavelā va duraccayāni.
ja527:41.1: Āhūniyo me si hitānukampī dhātā vidhātā c' asi kāmapālo, tayī hutā deva mahapphalā hi me, kāmena me Ummadantiṃ paṭiccha.
ja527:42.1: Addhā hi sabbaṃ Ahipārakā tuvaṃ dhammaṃ acārī mama kattaputta, añño nu te ko idha sotthikattā dipado naro aruṇe jīvaloke.
ja527:43.1: Tuvan nu seṭṭho, tvam anuttaro si, tvaṃ dhammagū dhammavidū sumedho, so dhammagutto ciram eva jīva, dhammañ ca me desaya dhammapāla.
ja527:44.1: Tad iṃgha Ahipāraka suṇohi vacanam mama, dhammaṃ te desayissāmi sataṃ āsevitaṃ ahaṃ.
ja527:45.1: Sādhu dhammaruci rājā, sādhu paññāṇavā naro, sādhu mittānaṃ adubbho, pāpass' akaraṇaṃ sukhaṃ.
ja527:46.1: Akkodhanassa vijite ṭhitadhammassa rājino sukhaṃ manussā āsetha sītacchāyāya saṃghare.
ja527:47.1: Na vāham etaṃ abhirocayāmi kammaṃ asamekkha kataṃ asādhuṃ, ye vāpi ñatvā na sayaṃ karonti, upamā imā mayhaṃ tuvaṃ suṇohi:
ja527:48.1: Gavañ ce taramānānaṃ jimhaṃ gacchati puṅgavo (III 111|17) sabbā tā jimhaṃ gacchanti nette jimhagate sati.
ja527:49.1: Evam evaṃ manussesu yo hoti seṭṭhasammato so ce adhammaṃ carati pag eva itarā pajā, sabbaṃ raṭṭhaṃ dukkhaṃ seti rājā ce hoti adhammiko.
ja527:50.1: Gavañ ce taramānānaṃ ujuṃ gacchati puṅgavo sabbā tā ujuṃ gacchanti nette ujugate sati.
ja527:51.1: Evam eva manussesu yo hoti seṭṭhasammato so ce pi dhammaṃ carati pag eva itarā pajā, sabbaṃ raṭṭhaṃ sukhaṃ seti rājā ce hoti dhammiko.
ja527:52.1: Na cāp' ahaṃ adhammena amarattam pi patthaye imaṃ vā paṭhaviṃ sabbaṃ vijetuṃ Ahipāraka.
ja527:53.1: Yaṃ hi kiñci manussesu ratanaṃ idha vijjati gāvo dāso hiraññañ ca vatthiyaṃ haricandanaṃ
ja527:54.1: [Assitthiyo ratanaṃ maṇikañca yañ cāp' ime candimasuriyā abhipālayanti] na tassa hetu visamaṃ careyya, majjhe Sivīnaṃ usabho 'mhi jāto.
ja527:55.1: Netā pitā uggato raṭṭhapālo dhammaṃ Sivīnaṃ apacāyamāno so dhammam evānuvicintayanto tasmā sake cittavase na vatto.
ja527:56.1: Addhā tuvaṃ mahārāja niccaṃ avyasanaṃ sivaṃ karissasi ciraṃ rajjaṃ, paññā hi tava tādisī.
ja527:57.1: Etaṃ te anumodāma yaṃ dhammaṃ na-ppamajjasi, dhammaṃ pamajja khattiyo raṭṭhā cavati issaro.
ja527:58.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja mātāpitusu khattiya (supra p. idha dhammaṃ caritvāna rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
ja527:59.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja puttadāresu khattiya, etc.
ja527:60.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja mittāmaccesu khattiya, etc.
ja527:61.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja vāhanesu balesu ca, etc.
ja527:62.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja gāmesu nigamesu ca, etc.
ja527:63.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja raṭṭhe janapadesu ca, etc.
ja527:64.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja samaṇe brāhmaṇesu ca, etc.
ja527:65.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja migapakkhīsu khattiya, etc.
ja527:66.1: Dhammañ cara mahārāja, dhammo ciṇṇo sukhāvaho, idha dhammaṃ caritvāna rāja saggaṃ gamissasi.
ja527:67.1: Idha dhammaṃ caritvāna saindadevā sabrahmakā suciṇṇena divam pattā, mā dhammaṃ rāja pamādo
